intro: The Harmony Coffee Table perfectly balances beauty, functionality, and convenience, creating a piece that complements your lifestyle and elevates your home.

features.title: A timeless walnut finish
features.text: Add timeless charm with a rich walnut shade featuring a matte finish, seamlessly blending with both contemporary and classic interiors for a refined look.

features.title: Built strong for everyday living
features.text: Crafted from 18mm prelaminated particle board, it ensures strength and durability to withstand everyday use, delivering long-lasting value to your home.

features.title: Compact design with maximum impact
features.text: A generous surface area offers ample space for coffee, books, or decorative items, creating a functional yet stylish focal point for your living room.

features.title: Open storage for easy access
features.text: Cleverly designed open compartments keep your essentials within arm’s reach, combining practicality and style for a clutter-free living experience.

features.title: Hassle-free setup, easy to move
features.text: Delivered in a flat-pack format, the table is quick and hassle-free to assemble, allowing you to transform your living space effortlessly.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
